hook_en: He is your hiding place today. 🙏
reflect_en: Midweek, when the waters feel like they're rising, David points us to prayer: God is a hiding place who protects us from trouble and promises to counsel us and watch over us on the way we should go.
q_en: Where do you need God's guidance this week?
x_en: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance.
tiktok: You are my hiding place 🙏 Psalm 32:6–8 — He will counsel you and watch over you
yt_title: You Are My Hiding Place | Psalm 32:6–8 #Shorts
li_open: Every leader needs counsel they didn't come up with.
li_quote: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
li_body: God promises to instruct, counsel and watch over those who pray to Him. Leaders who seek that counsel first, and pray with the people they serve, lead from a hiding place instead of from pressure.
reflect_es: A mitad de semana, cuando las aguas parecen crecer, David nos invita a orar: Dios es nuestro refugio, nos guarda de angustia y promete enseñarnos el camino en que debemos andar.
q_es: ¿En qué necesitas que Dios te guíe esta semana?
x_es: Tú eres mi refugio; me guardarás de angustia; con cánticos de liberación me rodearás.
